## Ftp Workflow

**Purpose**: n8n workflow: Ftp Workflow. 7 nodes wired together. Uses: ftp, scheduleTrigger, mqtt, mqttTrigger, convertToFile. Sourced from czlonkowski/Zie619 n8n-workflows community archive (workflows/Code/0553_Code_Schedule_Send_Scheduled.json). Configure credentials and any hardcoded IDs before activating.

**Services needed**: ftp, scheduleTrigger, mqtt, mqttTrigger, convertToFile, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: 5min-config

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating

_Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows_
_Curated by ai-ops-architect on 2026-05-05_
